nodes.label: Creates a moderately complex sketch for serialization testing.
Tests for the Importer contract compliance of SketchImporter.
Tests that importer class has required attributes.
Tests that scan() returns ImportManifest with correct data.
Tests that scan() handles invalid JSON gracefully.
Tests that parse() returns ParsingResult with correct data.
Tests that parse() returns None for invalid JSON.
Tests that a sketch can be serialized, imported, and correctly     reconstructed
Tests that if the JSON contains a name, it takes precedence over the     file na
Tests that if the JSON has no name (or empty), it falls back to the     file nam
Tests that if JSON has no name and no file is provided, the name     defaults to
Tests that the importer returns ImportResult with None payload for invalid     o
Tests that the mouse.rfs sketch can be imported and correctly     reconstructed
